hits.s: massive shale and claystone section from about 4375 feet to 6900 feet is not normally pressured. This conclusion is only weakly supported by logs. It is suspected this section could be drilled by mud weights as low as 10 PPG but tight hole and washout would probably be problem.

After setting 13 3/8 casing no additional mechanical problems were encountered but tight hole was problem. At least 61 hours were lost due to tight hole conditions in spite of running what should have been more than adequate mud properties.
